ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; approximately 90-95% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with 5-10% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels localized at distal tips and the central notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across 90% of the surface area. High-contrast white mottling clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes. A discrete, high-intensity white linear mark is located immediately adjacent to the right side of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with a calculated aperture angle of approximately 75 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of roughly 0.12 relative to the maximum visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude irregular serrations on the left lobe trailing edge characterized by two deep V-shaped indentations. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher frequency, lower-amplitude jagged peaks (approximately 10-12 distinct pixel-level variations).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave curve from the median notch extending toward the distal tips; the distal tips terminate in sharp, upward-swept points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters at the furthest lateral edges of both lobes, consistent with localized surface topography disruption.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple thin, diagonally oriented high-intensity linear disruptions visible on the dark surface of the left lobe and the lower section of the right lobe, oriented at roughly 45-degree angles to the fluke midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two significant jagged tissue irregularities (notches) on the trailing edge of the left lobe and smaller missing tissue sections along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent clusters of three-dimensional calcified organisms (barnacles) localized exclusively on the extreme lateral tips of the fluke.
